Method of Attack: Fraud campaign using Android apps to subscribe users to premium SMS subscription services without their knowledge
Apps pretended to be discount apps, games, custom keyboards, QR code scanners, video and photo editors, spam call blockers, camera filters
Apps collected phone number and email address, then subscribed victims to $40/month SMS services
Charges maximized based on victim location
Maintained presence on Google Play Store by using large number of apps despite takedown actions
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps on Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: 80 apps found on Google Play Store
Affected countries: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, UAE, USA (170,000 infected devices)
Subscription charges of $40 per month via SMS
Apps prompt for phone number and email address
